_note: Which test covers which source, addressed by stable id. Hand-maintained:
this repo has no registry generator, so an entry is only as true as whoever
wrote it. Add one when you add a test class or a suite; the fields that are
actually read are test_id, file, name, covered_components and
Granularity is the smallest unit with a stable name -- a unittest class,
which `python3 <file> <Class>` really can run alone. Execution is still
recorded as the containing file, because that is what runs: claiming
per-class execution nothing performs would be a coverage claim with no
observation behind it. test_install.sh is one entry for the whole file: its
sections share fixtures built earlier in the same run and cannot be started
Deliberately absent: the Java boot tests (agent/test/, run by BootTests).
They need a javac step and are not addressable as a file the way these are;
leaving them out says nothing about their coverage, and inventing an entry
that names a command nothing can run would.
covered_components names a path this suite really exercises. Do not widen
one to make a selector happy -- an entry that claims a file it never
touches turns a missing mapping into a false green.
